summary: Risk-isolated non-custodial DeFi lending protocol. Silo experienced a November 2023 GRAIL/USD oracle mispricing event that liquidated three users, while the protocol remained operational and later advanced to Silo v3, live on Ethereum, Arbitrum, and Avalanche in 2026.
what_happened: On 2023-11-22, GRAIL/USD pricing used by a Silo Arbitrum market deviated after anomalous HTX trading data entered DIA's feed. Three users became insolvent and were liquidated, with Silo governance reporting roughly USD 21,000 in liquidation losses/fees. DIA removed HTX as a source and tightened deviation controls. A later proposal to compensate the affected users in SILO tokens was defeated. Silo continued operating and Silo v3 remained live in 2026.
uncertainty_notes: The roughly USD 21,000 figure is the governance post's estimate of losses associated with the three liquidations, not a protocol-wide bad-debt figure. The defeated compensation proposal is not treated as realized recovery.
notes: DeFi backfill record. The historically significant oracle incident is modeled separately while current platform status remains active.
